Subject: CAIQ intake - single consolidated evidence bundle?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's architecture last week. As part of our vendor diligence we captured the attached CAIQ (spreadsheet) and would like to ask if you can: 

1) Confirm the mapping of Redwood's controls to the CAIQ rows we've flagged (column B).
2) Provide a consolidated evidence bundle (logs, diagrams, proof-of-control artifacts) grouped by CAIQ control id.
3) Tell us which controls are covered by Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployment options (we'll need to know any scope caveats).

We're aiming to complete our procurement review by 2027-06-18. If you can provide a target delivery or interim plan that would be great.

Subject: Re: CAIQ intake - single consolidated evidence bundle?

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the clear ask and the attachment — I reviewed the spreadsheet quickly. We can do a consolidated bundle and a control-by-control mapping, but there are a couple of practical notes up front: 

- Evidence scope: some CAIQ responses differ by deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). We'll mark per-control scope columns and call out any tenant-residency caveats.
- Live telemetry/log samples: we can provide sampled log extracts for runtime telemetry controls but need a narrow timebox and sampling window (we typically provide 48 hours of anonymized traces for sampling).
- Attachments and PII: we'll scrub any customer-specific identifiers from runtime logs prior to handoff.

Kimberly (cc'd) will assemble the initial mapping template and a manifest of artifacts we expect to deliver. Marissa, can you confirm whether Procurement at Nebula requires DocuSign for owner attestations or if a signed transmittal is enough?

Proposed quick plan:
- 2027-06-07: deliver control-index CSV and manifest for review.
- 2027-06-10: deliver first evidence batch (controls 1-60).
- 2027-06-14: deliver remaining evidence and closure notes.

If that timeline is too aggressive for your internal review cycles, tell us and we'll space it out.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: evidence_manifest_template.csv (we'll populate and upload to the shared Drive)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Turner <alice.turner@nebulasys.com>

Subject: Re: CAIQ intake - single consolidated evidence bundle? — mapping template attached

Hi all,

I've started the mapping and attached a CSV formatted manifest that follows Nebula's sheet headers plus our internal artifact IDs. Notes: 

- Column mapping: CAIQ identifier (e.g. CCM-01), proposed Redwood answer (Provided/NotApplicable/Partial), artifact_id, artifact_description, deployment_scope (hosted/dedicated/private), expected_delivery_date.
- Artifacts we plan to include in the first batch: SOC 2 report excerpt (control traces), network diagram v3 (redacted), runtime telemetry sample (anonymized), key rotation procedure (signed), and control owner attestations for policy-based controls.
- For controls we mark as "Partial" we'll include remediation notes and any compensating controls.

Action items for Alice/procurement: please confirm the sample window you prefer for telemetry (we recommend 2027-05-25 to 2027-05-27) and whether you need the SOC 2 full report or an excerpt.

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

3) Expected times: batch-1 (controls 1-60) -> 2027-06-10 EOD; batch-2 (61-120) -> 2027-06-12; final wrap and delivery -> 2027-06-14.

If you need an alternate cadence, we can compress but prefer to keep sampling and redaction reviews in place.
